project_name: Chatify AI - WhatsApp Conversations & Payment Verification Console

theme.emotional_tone: Crisp, authoritative, friction-free WhatsApp operations console with trustworthy financial clarity

layout_and_grids.inbox_container: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] bg-background border-t border-border/60 overflow-hidden
layout_and_grids.threads_sidebar: col-span-1 lg:col-span-3 border-r border-border/60 flex flex-col bg-white overflow-hidden
layout_and_grids.chat_viewport: col-span-1 lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col min-w-0 bg-[#F4F5F7] relative
layout_and_grids.customer_context_rail: col-span-1 lg:col-span-3 border-l border-border/60 flex flex-col bg-white overflow-y-auto

avatars.usage: WhatsApp user avatar fallback with online status dot

elements: Avatar with fallback initials or photo URL
Takeover / Return to AI Toggle CTA

rules: Inbound messages: White background with subtle 1px border, shadow-sm, aligned left
Outbound messages: WhatsApp light green tint (bg-[#DCF8C6] or bg-emerald-100/80) with dark green text, aligned right
Status ticks: Single check for sent, double grey checks for delivered, double blue checks for read
Immediate auto-scroll to latest message on selection or new message receive
Payment attachment cards rendered inline with image thumbnail and review status

features: Payment verification card in right rail showing uploaded screenshot preview
AI Extract: Transaction ID, Amount, Bank Name, UTR Match Status
Action Buttons: Approve Payment & Sync Shopify, Reject & Notify Customer
No duplicate spam: Sends exactly one confirmation message upon review decision
Anti-upsell guard: If customer declined upsell, block repeat recommendations

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign /app/frontend/src/pages/Conversations.jsx into a high-density, WhatsApp operations console.
Format customer phone numbers clearly using country code and spaces (e.g. '+91 98765 43210').
Display WhatsApp name alongside formatted phone number, profile image/avatar fallback, and verified customer badges.
Ensure outbound AI messages follow the 'single message response' rule by default, avoiding multi-message spam unless explicitly required for separate flow steps.
Enforce strict policy: do not trigger upsell or cross-sell messages once a customer has declined once.

Fix payment verification end-to-end: render payment screenshot preview, show UTR/amount extraction, provide instant Approve (Sync Shopify) / Reject actions with feedback toasts and live status updates.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements including headers, avatars, buttons, message status ticks, and payment review controls.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.hover_states: All buttons and selectable cards MUST have explicit hover and focus states with contrast compliance.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous padding (p-4 to p-6 in containers) to avoid text collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_backgrounds: Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or floating overlays; always apply glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.
